name: teamstation
description: TeamStation — video server and app, serving app.teamstation.app

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && mkdir -p lib/server/stats/fixtures && cp src/server/stats/fixtures/*.json lib/server/stats/fixtures/
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage.scripts && npm run coverage.app && npm run coverage.server && npm run coverage.changed.server
scripts.coverage.changed.app: c8 --reporter=json --report-dir coverage/changedApp --include 'src/app/player/**/*.ts' --exclude '**/*.test.ts' --exclude '**/*.e2e.ts' mocha -r sucrase/register -r ./src/test/scoringDomSetup.cjs --extension ts --spec 'src/app/player/**/*.test.ts' && node scripts/changed-line-check.cjs --coverage coverage/changedApp/coverage-final.json --ext .ts --allow-empty src/app/player
scripts.coverage.changed.server: c8 --reporter=json --report-dir coverage/changedServer --include 'src/**/*.ts' --exclude '**/*.test.ts' --exclude '**/*.e2e.ts' mocha -r sucrase/register --extension ts --spec 'src/**/*.test.ts' --ignore '**/node_modules/**' --ignore 'lib/**' && node scripts/changed-line-check.cjs --coverage coverage/changedServer/coverage-final.json --ext .ts --exclude src/server/index.ts --exclude src/server/statsBuilder/start.ts src/server src/common src/migrate
scripts.coverage.scripts: c8 --reporter=json --report-dir coverage/scripts --include 'scripts/changed-line-*.cjs' --include scripts/swift-changed-line-coverage.cjs mocha -r sucrase/register --extension ts --spec src/test/changedLineCoverage.test.ts --spec src/test/coverageScripts.test.ts && node scripts/changed-line-check.cjs --coverage coverage/scripts/coverage-final.json --ext .cjs scripts/changed-line-coverage.cjs scripts/changed-line-check.cjs scripts/swift-changed-line-coverage.cjs
scripts.coverage.server: node src/migrate/requirePostgres18.js && c8 --all --reporter=text --check-coverage --lines 90 --include src/common/userIdNumber.ts --include src/server/db/int8.ts --include src/common/gumboEventTypes.ts --include src/common/gumboPlay.ts --include src/server/events/**/*.ts --include src/server/routes/events.ts --include src/server/routes/teams.ts --include src/server/stats/records.ts --include src/server/routes/logs.ts --include src/server/teams/resolveOpponent.ts --include src/server/teams/createTeam.ts --include src/server/teams/followMerges.ts --include src/server/db/externalIds.ts --include src/server/db/advisoryLocks.ts --include src/common/createTeam.ts --include src/common/teamMembers.ts --include src/common/externalIds.ts --include src/server/teams/addPlayers.ts --include src/server/teams/addAdults.ts --include src/server/teams/storeTeamPictures.ts --include src/server/routes/teamMembers.ts --include src/server/teams/teamNames.ts --include src/common/scheduleGames.ts --include 'src/server/schedule/**/*.ts' --include src/server/routes/schedule.ts --include src/migrate/migrations/041scheduleApi.ts --include src/migrate/migrations/042fenceDistance.ts --include src/migrate/migrations/043roleFlags.ts --include src/migrate/migrations/044teamDefaultLineup.ts --include src/migrate/migrations/045walkUpSongs.ts --include src/migrate/migrations/046externalCleanup.ts --include src/migrate/migrations/048dropStatRollups.ts --include src/migrate/runner.ts --include src/migrate/schemaSnapshot.ts --include src/common/scoring/lineupHistory.ts --include src/server/routes/lineups.ts --include src/server/routes/walkUpSongs.ts --include 'src/server/socket/*.ts' --include src/common/roles.ts --include src/common/playerSettings.ts --include src/server/access.ts --include src/server/invites/people.ts --include src/server/routes/manage.ts --include src/server/routes/me.ts --include src/server/routes/players.ts --include src/server/routes/director.ts --include src/server/routes/directorUploads.ts --include src/server/routes/live.ts --include src/server/teams/teamRoster.ts --include src/common/fenceDistance.ts --include 'src/server/games/**/*.ts' --include src/server/jsonBody.ts --include src/common/scoreboard.ts --include src/common/scoreboardEvents.ts --include src/common/scoring/scoreboardOf.ts --include 'src/server/scoreboard/**/*.ts' --include src/server/routes/scoreboard.ts --include src/server/director/runGames.ts --include src/server/scoring/replayContext.ts --include 'src/server/dictation/**/*.ts' --include src/server/routes/health.ts --include src/server/serverConfig.ts mocha -r sucrase/register --extension ts --spec 'src/**/*.test.ts' --ignore '**/node_modules/**' --ignore 'lib/**'
scripts.test: node scripts/build-scoring-tests.mjs && node scripts/checkScoringLayering.mjs && mocha -r sucrase/register -r ./src/test/scoringDomSetup.cjs --extension ts --spec 'src/**/*.test.ts' --spec lib/scoring-tests.cjs --ignore '**/node_modules/**'
scripts.test:builds-ui: node scripts/build-builds-ui-tests.mjs && mocha -r sucrase/register -r ./src/test/scoringDomSetup.cjs lib/builds-tests.cjs src/common/distribution.test.ts src/app/navigation/routes.test.ts
scripts.coverage.deploy: c8 --all --include 'scripts/deploy.ts' --include 'scripts/deploy/**/*.ts' --exclude '**/*.test.ts' --report-dir coverage/deploy --reporter text --reporter json --reporter lcov --check-coverage --per-file --lines 90 mocha -r sucrase/register --timeout 15000 'scripts/deploy/**/*.test.ts'
scripts.coverage.mason: c8 --all --include Masonfile.ts --include scripts/deploy/mason.ts --report-dir coverage/mason --reporter text --reporter json --check-coverage --per-file --lines 90 mocha -r sucrase/register --timeout 15000 scripts/deploy/masonEntry.test.ts
